name: Fever (Elevated Body Temperature >= 38 C)
description: Measured or felt systemic elevation in body temperature above standard normal range.
question: Do you have an elevated body temperature (fever >= 38 C / 100.4 F)?

name: High Fever (>= 39 C / 102.2 F)
description: Significantly elevated body temperature indicating pronounced systemic inflammatory response.
question: Is your fever particularly high (>= 39 C / 102.2 F)?

name: Cough
description: Reflex action to clear airways of mucus and irritants.
question: Do you have a persistent or frequent cough?

name: Sore Throat (Pharyngitis)
description: Pain, scratchiness, or irritation of the throat that often worsens when swallowing.
question: Do you have throat irritation, pain, or scratchiness?

name: Nasal Congestion / Stuffy Nose
description: Blockage of nasal passages due to swollen membranes from inflamed blood vessels.
question: Are your nasal passages congested or blocked?

name: Body Aches / Myalgia
description: Generalized muscle soreness and discomfort frequently accompanying viral systemic infections.
question: Are you experiencing generalized muscle aches or soreness across your body?

name: Fatigue / Malaise
description: Overall feeling of tiredness, lack of energy, or systemic weakness.
question: Do you feel significant fatigue, exhaustion, or general malaise?

name: Chills / Shivering
description: Feeling of coldness with involuntary shivering during an ascending phase of fever.
question: Are you experiencing shivering episodes or feeling unusually chilled?

name: Rapid / Abrupt Symptom Onset (Within Hours)
description: Sudden initiation of acute symptoms occurring over a span of a few hours rather than days.
question: Did your symptoms begin suddenly over a few hours rather than developing gradually?

name: Paroxysmal Sneezing
description: Repeated involuntary expulsions of air from the nose and mouth.
question: Are you experiencing bouts of repeated sneezing?

name: Clear / Watery Runny Nose
description: Thin, watery, clear nasal discharge typical of allergic irritation or early viral infection.
question: Do you have a clear, watery runny nose?

name: Itchy / Watery Eyes (Allergic Conjunctivitis)
description: Pruritus, redness, and lacrimation of both eyes associated with environmental allergens.
question: Are your eyes itchy, red, or excessively watery?

name: Itchy Nose or Palate
description: Localized pruritus in the nasal mucosa or roof of the mouth.
question: Do you experience an itchy sensation inside your nose or on the roof of your mouth?

name: Known Allergen Exposure Trigger
description: Onset or worsening of symptoms following contact with pollen, dust, pet dander, or mold.
question: Were your symptoms triggered or worsened by exposure to pollen, dust, animals, or changes in season?

name: Headache (General)
description: Pain or discomfort located anywhere in the cranial region.
question: Do you have a headache?

name: Unilateral Pulsating / Throbbing Headache
description: Pulsating or throbbing cranial pain predominantly localized to one side of the head.
question: Is the headache throbbing/pulsating and mostly on one side of your head?

name: Photophobia / Light Sensitivity
description: Discomfort or pain in the eyes triggered by normal ambient lighting.
question: Are your eyes unusually sensitive or painful in normal room light or sunlight?

name: Phonophobia / Sound Sensitivity
description: Heightened discomfort or pain induced by ordinary everyday sounds.
question: Do normal sounds feel uncomfortably loud or worsen your headache?

name: Visual Aura (Flickering Lights / Blind Spots)
description: Transient neurological visual disturbances preceding or accompanying headache attacks.
question: Did you notice zigzag lines, flashing lights, or blind spots before or during the headache?

name: Headache Worsened by Routine Physical Activity
description: Aggravation of cranial discomfort by walking, climbing stairs, or head movement.
question: Does walking, climbing stairs, or moving your head aggravate the headache pain?

name: Nausea
description: Unpleasant sensation of inclination to vomit.
question: Are you feeling nauseous or sick to your stomach?

name: Vomiting
description: Involuntary oral expulsion of gastric contents.
question: Have you vomited or had episodes of retching?

name: Frequent Watery Diarrhea
description: Passage of loose or liquid stools three or more times within a 24-hour period.
question: Are you experiencing loose, watery stools three or more times a day?

name: Abdominal Cramping / Pain (Mild to Moderate)
description: Intermittent colicky discomfort or spasms in the abdominal region.
question: Do you have intermittent abdominal cramps or tummy ache?

name: Dysuria (Burning Sensation During Urination)
description: Painful, burning, or stinging sensation experienced during micturition.
question: Do you experience pain or a burning sensation when passing urine?

name: Urinary Frequency (Frequent Small Urination)
description: Need to urinate much more frequently than normal, often voiding only small amounts.
question: Are you needing to urinate much more often than usual, voiding small amounts?

name: Urinary Urgency (Sudden Compelling Need to Void)
description: Sudden, compelling, and difficult-to-defer urge to urinate.
question: Do you feel a sudden, intense urge to urinate that cannot be deferred?

name: Suprapubic Discomfort / Lower Pelvic Pressure
description: Aching or heaviness in the lower central pelvic area just above the pubic bone.
question: Do you feel discomfort, heaviness, or pressure in your lower pelvis above the pubic area?

name: Flank Pain / Costovertebral Angle Tenderness
description: Pain situated in the lower back or side between the ribs and the hip.
question: Do you have pain in your lower back or side between your ribs and hips?

name: Chest Pain / Pressure (RED FLAG)
description: Severe, crushing, radiating, or unexplained pain, tightness, or pressure in the chest.
question: Do you have chest pain, pressure, tightness, or pain radiating to your jaw/left arm?

name: Severe Shortness of Breath (RED FLAG)
description: Inability to breathe adequately, gasping at rest, or blue lips/fingertips.
question: Are you experiencing severe difficulty breathing, struggle to speak full sentences, or gasping at rest?

name: Sudden Neurological Deficit (RED FLAG)
description: Sudden facial drooping, arm/leg weakness or numbness, slurred speech, or confusion.
question: Have you noticed sudden facial drooping, one-sided weakness/numbness, speech difficulty, or severe confusion?

name: Stiff Neck with High Fever (RED FLAG)
description: Inability to flex chin to chest accompanied by severe fever, confusion, or altered consciousness.
question: Do you have severe neck stiffness (inability to touch chin to chest) combined with high fever?

name: Severe Unrelenting Abdominal Pain (RED FLAG)
description: Sudden rigid, excruciating, or unrelenting abdominal pain suggesting peritonitis or visceral perforation.
question: Is your abdominal pain extraordinarily severe, rigid, agonizing, or worsening rapidly without relief?

name: Loss of Taste or Smell (Anosmia / Ageusia)
description: Sudden reduction or complete loss of the ability to smell aromas or taste food flavors.
question: Have you suddenly lost your sense of taste or smell?

name: Productive Cough with Phlegm / Mucus
description: Coughing that brings up noticeable secretions, mucus, or phlegm from the bronchial tree.
question: Are you coughing up phlegm, mucus, or thick secretions?

name: Wheezing / Whistling Breath
description: High-pitched coarse whistling sound produced during breathing due to narrowed airways.
question: Do you hear a whistling or squeaking sound when you breathe out (wheezing)?

name: Facial Pain / Pressure (Cheeks or Forehead)
description: Aching pressure, tenderness, or heaviness over the sinuses, cheeks, or forehead, often worse leaning forward.
question: Do you feel fullness, pressure, or aching pain across your cheeks, forehead, or around your eyes?

name: Thick Yellow or Green Nasal Discharge
description: Opaque, thick, yellow, or greenish nasal secretions indicating significant neutrophil mucosal infiltration.
question: Is your nasal mucus cloudy, thick, yellow, or greenish?

name: White Spots / Exudates on Tonsils
description: Visible white or yellow spots, flecks, or patches of pus on swollen palatine tonsils.
question: Can you see white spots, pus patches, or coatings on your tonsils or throat?

name: Swollen / Tender Neck Lymph Nodes
description: Enlarged, sensitive, or painful lymph glands felt beneath the jaw or along the front of the neck.
question: Are the lymph nodes in the front of your neck swollen, tender, or painful to the touch?

name: Dull Band-Like Headache (Both Sides)
description: Non-pulsating, pressing, or dull aching head discomfort encircling the forehead and back of head like a tight band.
question: Does your headache feel like a tight band or heavy weight pressing around both sides of your head?

name: Neck and Shoulder Muscle Tension / Stiffness
description: Tightness, aching, or soreness in the posterior neck and trapezius muscles without true meningeal rigidity.
question: Are your neck and shoulder muscles tight, achy, or stiff?

name: Heartburn / Burning Chest Sensation Behind Breastbone
description: Burning sensation rising from the upper abdomen or lower chest up into the throat.
question: Do you have a burning sensation behind your breastbone or in your chest (heartburn)?

name: Acid Regurgitation / Sour Taste in Mouth
description: Unpleasant sour, acidic, or bitter fluid flowing back up into the mouth or back of throat.
question: Do you feel sour or bitter fluid backing up into your throat or mouth?

name: Symptoms Worse After Eating or Lying Down
description: Exacerbation of chest or upper abdominal discomfort when resting flat or shortly after large meals.
question: Do your symptoms worsen after eating heavy meals or when you lie flat in bed?

name: Earache / Ear Pain (Otalgia)
description: Sharp, dull, or throbbing pain localized inside one or both ears.
question: Do you have pain, aching, or throbbing inside your ear?

name: Ear Fullness / Muffled Hearing
description: Sensation of pressure, clogged ears, or transiently muffled hearing.
question: Does your ear feel clogged, full of pressure, or is your hearing muffled?

name: Red, Pink, or Bloodshot Eyes
description: Hyperemia and dilation of conjunctival blood vessels causing red or pink discoloration of the sclera.
question: Are the whites of your eyes visibly red, pink, or bloodshot?

name: Visible Blood in Stool / Black Tarry Stool (RED FLAG)
description: Presence of red blood, blood clots, or black tarry stools indicating lower or upper GI tract bleeding.
question: Have you noticed bright red blood in your stool or black, sticky, tar-like bowel movements?

name: Chest Pain Radiating to Left Arm, Jaw, or Back (RED FLAG)
description: Chest discomfort or heaviness spreading to the left shoulder, left arm, neck, jaw, or shoulder blades.
question: Does your chest pain spread to your left arm, shoulder, jaw, neck, or back?

name: Cold Sweats / Profuse Clamminess (RED FLAG)
description: Sudden breakout of cold, clammy sweat accompanying pain, lightheadedness, or nausea.
question: Have you broken out in a cold, clammy sweat along with your symptoms?

name: Fainting / Sudden Loss of Consciousness (RED FLAG)
description: Transient loss of consciousness, blackout episode, or collapse.
question: Have you passed out, fainted, blacked out, or collapsed?

name: Coughing Up Blood / Bloody Sputum (RED FLAG)
description: Expectoration of bright red blood or blood-streaked sputum from the respiratory tract.
question: Are you coughing up bright red blood or noticeable streaks of blood in your phlegm?

name: Severe Pain in Lower Right Abdomen (RED FLAG)
description: Persistent sharp, localized tenderness or rebound pain in the right lower quadrant of the abdomen.
question: Do you have severe, sharp pain focused specifically in your lower right abdomen?

name: Rapidly Spreading Red, Warm, Swollen Skin
description: Expanding area of erythema, local warmth, swelling, and tenderness suggesting bacterial soft tissue cellulitis.
question: Do you have a patch of skin that is hot, swollen, painful, and spreading outward?

name: Itchy Raised Red Welts / Hives (Urticaria)
description: Transient, highly pruritic, raised edematous plaques with central clearing caused by histamine release.
question: Do you have raised, itchy red welts or hives that appear and disappear across your skin?

name: Joint Pain, Stiffness, or Swelling
description: Aching discomfort, morning stiffness, or visible enlargement in one or more joints.
question: Are you experiencing pain, morning stiffness, or swelling in your joints?
